sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Vapor Deposition of Amorphous Silicon Cesium Iodide DR Detectors

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law framework with Anglo-American commercial and maritime law influences (Hybrid)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama-United States Bilateral Investment Treaty (entered into force 1991)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015, as amended by Ley No. 70 de 2019 and Ley No. 9 de 2020 (AML/CFT framework establishing the Unidad de Análisis Financiero - UAF), together with Decreto Ejecutivo No. 560 de 2015, Decreto Ejecutivo No. 262 de 2019 and the related Public Registry Resoluciones implementing the ultimate beneficial ownership register (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) executed by each intended shareholder and director in favor of the designated Panamanian attorney-in-fact
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder/director jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the country of origin is a party to the Apostille Convention; otherwise consular legalization by the Panamanian Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the corporate certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, and board resolution of the corporate shareholder (if the shareholder is an entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official Companies Registry or equivalent corporate register of the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, for non-Hague Convention states, consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport / national ID of each ultimate beneficial owner, director, and authorized signatory, together with entitlement evidence (e.g., shareholding certificate or beneficial ownership declaration)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national registry, notary, or public authority of the person's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization when required; otherwise notarized certification plus FBI/background verification when available

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors, officers, and counterparties against the UN Security Council sanctions lists (1267/1989, 2253), OFAC SDN/Non-SDN lists, EU Consolidated List, Panama's domestic PEP list maintained by the UAF, and the Panamanian Public Registry of Excluded Persons; PEP-related and close-associate relationships require enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth review, and senior management approval before incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá - Sede Electrónica (RENAM / Online Services Portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish or any language written in the Latin alphabet; names in non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into Latin characters; the exact suffix 'S.A.' or 'Sociedad Anónima' is mandatory; names containing numerals, excessive punctuation, or more than 30 contiguous characters may be rejected at the registrar's discretion, and no proposed name may be identical or confusingly similar to an existing or reserved name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a written Recurso de Reposición with the Directorate of the Public Registry within five business days of the rejection, attaching the original rejection sheet and any supporting evidence of distinctiveness; if the reconsideration is denied, an appeal (Recurso de Apelación) may be lodged within ten business days with the Third Administrative Chamber of the Supreme Court. Name reservation extension requires a fresh application and payment of a new tariff before the initial thirty-day window lapses; no automatic extension is granted.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is accepted solely as the statutory registered agent address. For the actual scope under ISIC 3250 — including OEM assembly, warehousing, and distribution of digital X-ray flat-panel detectors — the Ministry of Health (MINSA) and the Ministry of Commerce and Industries require a demonstrable physical operating site, local personnel, inventory records, and safety certifications; a purely virtual office structure without physical operational substance is insufficient and may trigger license suspension, registry review, or adverse UBO verification findings.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: For an active OEM manufacturing/medical-device entity with local physical presence, the likelihood of unannounced on-site inspection by MINSA or the Municipality is quantified at 8–12% annually during the first two operating years; for a passive registered-agent-only shell with no operations or physical substance, the inspection probability is 1–3%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and reservation certificate (Certificado de Búsqueda)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Public Registry fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the incorporation deed (Escritura de Constitución) before a Panamanian notary
Registration of the incorporation deed and issuance of the Certificado de Registro
First-year resident registered agent and Panamanian legal representative services
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Panamanian law firm or fiduciary agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO initial filing and compliance verification under Ley No. 70 de 2019
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Public Registry and licensed compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Decree-based tariff and statutory verification fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille / consular legalization of foreign corporate and identity documents (up to three sets)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Chancellery) or competent foreign apostille authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document state fee, apostille certification, and courier cost

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT PEP and sanctions due diligence, risk profiling, and beneficial ownership verification for all UBOs, directors, and principal counterparties

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for risk-based KYC/UBO due diligence bundle

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (Régimen de Sociedades Anónimas), as amended by Ley No. 4 de 2010; Articles 1-7 (formation and inscription), 13-18 (share capital and shares), 49-57 (board of directors and officers); subsidiary application of the Código de Comercio de Panamá and Ley No. 38 de 2000 (Administrative Procedure Law).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Registry of Legal Entities), Dirección General del Registro Público, Panama City
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) containing the Pacto Social (Articles of Association) and Estatutos (Bylaws), inscribed in the Registro Público de Panamá
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Panamanian S.A.; the Articles may declare an authorized capital, customarily US$10,000 divided into 100 shares. No escrow deposit or prior capital contribution is required at formation. For this manufacturing venture, the Board will evidence subscribed capital of at least US$100,000 to satisfy DGI, municipal, and bank counterparty due diligence.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — [S.A. NAME]: UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. 1. SHARE SUBSCRIPTION: The Board approves the subscription and issuance of the founding share capital to the initial subscribers, with the authorized capital deemed fully or partially paid as provided in the Articles of Incorporation. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered office at [Address], Panama City, Republic of Panama, is adopted as the sole corporate, tax, and administrative domicile. 3. OFFICERS: The Board appoints a President, a Secretary, and a Treasurer. 4. AUTHORIZATION: The President and Secretary are jointly authorized to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and file all statutory applications before the Registro Público, DGI, MICI, and the Municipality. 5. RATIFICATION: All acts performed by promoters prior to incorporation are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Search, Reservation, and Availability Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sede Electrónica (online) / Oficina de Revisión de Nombres, Sección de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online name-search request through the Registro Público Sede Electrónica for the proposed style ending in 'S.A.' or 'Sociedad Anónima'. Verify that no identical or notoriously similar company or trademark name is registered. Reserve the approved name for the statutory term and obtain the certificate of availability to annex to the incorporation deed.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name (submit 1 to 3 alternatives)
Identification document of the registered agent or incorporator
Online name-search request form
Name-reservation fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry refuses the name on grounds of similarity or prohibited wording, the agent may file a written reconsideration request (recurso de reconsideración) within 3 business days, or simply reserve the next available alternative name and proceed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution, and Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública del Circuito de Panamá (Notary Public of the First Judicial Circuit, Panama City)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered Panamanian attorney drafts the Escritura Pública de Constitución containing the corporate name, general purpose (including manufacture of digital X-ray flat-panel detectors and amorphous silicon/cesium iodide deposition), authorized share capital, share classes, number of directors, names of subscribers and initial directors, registered office, and term. All subscribers and the named directors must appear before the Notary, be identified by passport, and sign the deed, which is then protocolized. Pay the applicable notarial and stamp fees and request executed testimonies.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of all subscribers and elected directors
Draft Pacto Social and Estatutos prepared by counsel
Evidence of standing of the Panamanian registered agent (abogado idóneo)
Corporate name reservation certificate from Step 1
Payment receipt for notarial and fiscal stamps
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary or counsel detects defects, the deed is returned for correction before signing; any defect found after execution is cured by a separate corrective deed (escritura de rectificación o aclaratoria) executed by the same parties before the Notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription of the Public Deed in the Registry of Legal Entities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Visto Bueno Legal / Firma de Registro), Panama City
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized original testimonio of the Escritura Pública de Constitución to the Sección de Personas Jurídicas for legal review. Upon approval, the deed receives the Firma de Registro and is transcribed into the Registry; the Registry issues the official Certificado de Registro and testimonies evidencing the legal personality of the S.A. Request at least two certified testimonies for subsequent government and bank filings.
required_dossiers: Notarized testimonio of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
Certified copies of subscribers' and directors' identification
Registry inscription fee deposit slip (derechos de registro)
Cover letter from the registered agent referencing the application docket
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a notice of defects (reparos), the registered agent files the corrective instrument within the granted term, typically 5 to 10 business days. If the Registry fails to act beyond 15 business days, the agent may file an administrative complaint before the Director General of the Registro Público or seek judicial relief by writ of amparo.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration with the RUC and Activation of Withholding-Agent Obligations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), Sede Electrónica / Agencia del Contribuyente, Panama City
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A. in the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) using the corporate testimonios, declaring the principal activity as 'fabricación de detectores de rayos X de panel plano' (ISIC 3250) and the domicile as the registered office. Obtain the corporate RUC/NIT, create the taxpayer electronic account for filing the annual income tax return (ISR) and monthly ITBMS returns, and register the company as employer and withholding agent for salaries and non-resident payments.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Registro / testimonio of the incorporated S.A.
RUC registration form (inscripción de contribuyente)
Certified copies of directors' identification and registered agent licence
Lease agreement or public-utility invoice evidencing the registered office
Declaration of accounting books and authorized signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI rejects the activity code or domicile, the taxpayer cures the record by filing a corrected RUC application and submitting the lease and receipts. A formal refusal may be appealed under the Código Procesal Tributario (Ley No. 76 de 2019) before the tax administration and, ultimately, the Fiscal Tribunal within the statutory term.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial and Municipal Commercial Registration — Aviso de Operación and Municipal Operating Licence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) — Dirección General de Empresas / Ventanilla de Aviso de Operación, jointly with the Alcaldía Municipal del Distrito de Panamá (Dirección de Licencias)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of commencing operations, file Form 1-A (Aviso de Operación) with MICI declaring the industrial manufacturing activity (CIUU 3250) and annexing the RUC certificate and corporate testimonios. After MICI stamps the notice, present it to the Alcaldía, pay the municipal patent fee calculated on declared capital, and obtain the Licencia Municipal de Aviso y Funcionamiento identifying the manufacturing plant address for physical inspection.
required_dossiers: Form 1-A Aviso de Operación (MICI)
RUC/NIT certificate issued by DGI
Certificado de Registro of the S.A. and directors' appointment minute
Identification of the legal representative
Lease or title deed of the industrial premises
Preliminary fire-safety certificate and municipal patent fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MICI or the municipality issues an objection to the activity code, address, or patent base, the applicant files an amended Form 1-A and supporting documents. An administrative appeal may be lodged under Ley No. 38 de 2000 within 5 business days of notification of the adverse decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer Registration with Social Security and Occupational Health Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) — Dirección Nacional de Afiliación y Registro; Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) — Inspección de Higiene y Seguridad Ocupacional
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A. as an employer (empresa patrono) with CSS, affiliate all payroll employees, and open the monthly quota payment account. File the workplace registration with MITRADEL for the industrial plant, establish the Joint Occupational Health and Safety Committee (Comité de Higiene y Seguridad) where payroll exceeds ten workers, and adopt the workplace risk prevention plan before hiring personnel for the deposition and assembly lines.
required_dossiers: CSS employer registration form and corporate testimonios
RUC/NIT certificate of the S.A.
Board resolution appointing officers and legal representative
Employee payroll list (planilla) with identification numbers
Industrial plant address and description of manufacturing processes
MITRADEL workplace registration form and safety plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If CSS or MITRADEL detects payroll or classification discrepancies, corrected schedules and supporting records are filed within the granted term. Any labor-inspection finding is cured by an approved corrective-action plan; penalties under the Código de Trabajo apply only after failure to remedy the identified violation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) — Dirección de Regulación y Fiscalización Industrial; sanitary and medical-device establishment oversight by the Ministerio de Salud (MINSA), Dirección de Atención al Paciente / Regulación Sanitaria
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación Industrial (MICI) and Licencia Municipal de Aviso y Funcionamiento, supplemented by the Registro Sanitario de Establecimiento (MINSA) for the medical-device manufacturing plant

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de la República de Panamá (MiAMBIENTE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría II — Estudio de Impacto Ambiental (EsIA) semidetallado, requiring a MiAMBIENTE environmental licence (Permiso Ambiental) for the vapor-deposition and electronics manufacturing plant under Decreto Ejecutivo No. 2 de 12 de enero de 2009; a Categoría I Informe Ambiental is available only if the facility uses no hazardous solvents and generates no significant effluents, which is not assumed for this cesium iodide detector process.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Ley No. 41 de 1998 (Ley General del Ambiente) and MiAMBIENTE technical regulations: industrial wastewater discharges must meet the effluent limits set by applicable DGNTI-COPANIT and MiAMBIENTE water-quality standards (pH range 6.0–9.0, BOD5, COD, and TSS within published national thresholds); VOC emissions from coating and deposition chambers must be captured and abated with at least 95% control efficiency; all hazardous solvent waste (acetone, isopropanol, etchants) must be stored in secondary containment, manifested, and transported by MiAMBIENTE-licensed hazardous-waste carriers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá: fire-safety inspection and issuance of the Certificado de Requisitos de Seguridad Contra Incendios covering alarms, extinguishers, egress, and cleanroom fire suppression; municipal engineering office: structural load clearance certifying floor capacity for deposition and heavy X-ray test equipment; MITRADEL: occupational hygiene clearance, including radiation shielding verification for energized X-ray detector test stations and a personal dosimetry program for workers exposed to radiation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); e-administration via the SIT (Sistema Integrado Tributario) portal and the DGI eFactura electronic-invoicing platform; customs control by the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the Sociedad Anónima at the Registro Público de Panamá through a licensed attorney (3–5 business days) and appoint a resident agent (Agente Residente). 2) Obtain an advanced electronic signature (Firma Electrónica) certificate from a Registro Público-authorized certification authority. 3) File the incorporation deed, corporate data form and notarized Aviso de Operación (municipal business-activity notice) with the DGI through the SIT portal to obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente). 4) Activate the ITBMS taxpayer account in the eFactura platform, or apply for the small-taxpayer simplified regime only when annual gross receipts are below B/.36,000. 5) Register with the Caja del Seguro Social (CSS) only if local staff are hired. No minimum paid-in capital applies and 100% non-resident ownership is permitted.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope (the S.A. is an entity-level taxpayer taxed exclusively on Panama-source income; foreign-source profits are exempt under Art. 693 of the Código Fiscal; no pass-through treatment exists for an S.A. under Panamanian law).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists; classification follows the Panamanian legal form, and territorial taxation is non-electable. Applicable optional regimes obtainable by DGI/municipal application: SEM Multinational Headquarters (Law 41 of 2007), Ciudad del Saber (Law 6 of 1998), Pan-Pacific special economic zone and Colon Free Zone regimes. Affiliated groups may elect consolidated corporate income-tax filing subject to prior DGI authorization.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios), a VAT-type tax on transfers of tangible goods and services; selective rates of 10% and 15% apply to alcohol, tobacco, fuel and certain tourism services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Registration is mandatory from the first taxable operation; there is no general de minimis ITBMS threshold (local currency B/. — Panamanian Balboa, pegged 1:1 to the US dollar). A simplified small-taxpayer regime (Régimen Especial de Pequeños Contribuyentes) is available only where annual gross receipts do not exceed B/.36,000 (US$36,000), with a flat monthly ITBMS payment; no sub-national ITBMS threshold exists.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing is mandatory under Law 130 of 2019, Decree 57 of 2020 and the DGI eFactura technical regulation. All ITBMS taxpayers issue e-Factura, e-Ticket and e-Export documents through DGI-certified software or the free DGI portal, authenticated with the Firma Electrónica advanced signature. Fiscal clearance is real-time: the eFactura engine validates each document, allocates a sequential CAF authorization range and returns a digital acceptance stamp before the document can be delivered to the buyer. Machine-to-machine integration runs on DGI-specified XML/JSON web-service APIs. Phased implementation concluded by 1 January 2024: all taxpayers must operate exclusively on the electronic-invoicing platform, and non-validated paper invoices confer no input-tax credit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Tangible goods are zero-rated when title transfers to a non-resident buyer and the goods physically depart Panamanian customs territory, evidenced by the DUCA export declaration and the e-Export invoice. Services are zero-rated when rendered to a non-resident for exclusive use and benefit outside Panama (offshore-consumption criterion), invoiced in the eFactura export format; the exporter must retain proof of the non-resident recipient and of collection in the exporter's bank account. Supplies to Colon Free Zone licensees, SEM companies and vessels in international transit also qualify under their specific regimes.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración Única Aduanera (DUCA) / SICE export declaration evidencing physical exit
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or road-cargo manifest issued to the non-resident buyer
e-Export commercial invoice carrying the DGI digital acceptance stamp
Inward Remittance Certificate, SWIFT MT103 or bank credit advice evidencing collection of export proceeds
Signed packing list, plus certificate of origin when required by the destination customs territory
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI and the ANA cross-match DUCA records, e-Export invoices and bank remittances in export audits. If zero-rating is disallowed or documentation proves false: the 7% ITBMS is retroactively assessed with monthly moratory interest of 1.5% plus a 10% late-payment surcharge; fines under the Código Fiscal range from B/.250 to B/.10,000 per invoice irregularity and up to 100% of the omitted tax for fraud; criminal tax-fraud and customs-smuggling prosecution may impose imprisonment of up to 5 years, monetary penalties and director disqualification. The DGI clawback/assessment period is 5 years (Art. 732 Código Fiscal), tolled upon proof of fraud. Panamanian law imposes no statutory FX-repatriation deadline; 180 days constitutes the local banking and audit expectation for export collections.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP). Panama has no issuing central bank; Banco Nacional de Panamá operates as the fiscal agent and clearing agent of the Republic of Panama.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama is fully dollarized with the US dollar as legal tender and the balboa limited to local coinage. There is no central bank exchange-control regime. Current account and capital account transfers are freely convertible and may be executed with no prior central bank authorization. Profit remittance and dividend distribution to non-residents are unimpeded, subject only to standard AML/KYC documentary requirements and, where Panama-source income is involved, confirmation of tax standing with the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. Panama imposes no foreign-exchange surrender obligation and no statutory conversion ratio on export proceeds. An exporter may retain 100% of export receipts in USD or in any freely convertible currency without repatriation deadline or compulsory conversion. Banking compliance requires standard proof of export trade, such as invoices, bills of lading, and customs documentation.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low-to-Medium. A purely offshore digital EMI without a Panamanian licence cannot lawfully hold client funds or provide payment/clearing services in Panama. The SBP is the sole licensing authority for banking and financial intermediation; there is no EU/UK EMI passporting regime. A cross-border EMI may only engage through a licensed Panamanian bank, a licensed international banking centre, or an approved SBP sandbox participant with a local office, local director/representative, and an AML/CFT program registered with the SBP. For the stated manufacturing entity, direct fintech-EMI clearing is not recommended; commercial banking with SWIFT and documentary LC capability is the viable rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally required for non-resident directors and ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs). First-time corporate account opening in Panama customarily requires original identification documents, a notarized or apostilled certificate of corporate existence, certified copy of the share register, and an in-person bank interview. Remote opening is rarely available to non-resident entities; some institutions permit a video-KYC interview supplemented by a local Panamanian attorney or notary with a power of attorney to represent the directors. For a foreign-owned S.A. in the medical-device hardware sector, physical attendance by one director or a locally appointed authorized signatory with corporate officer authorization is the strongest onboarding posture.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident S.A. affiliation with low-tax or high-secrecy jurisdiction; no economic substance visible.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide certified corporate documents from the Registro Público de Panamá, registered-agent confirmation, director and shareholder registers, audited financial statements of the controlling shareholder, lease or office agreement for the local registered office, operations and sales contracts, and a board resolution confirming the company's true substance as an ISO 13485 medical-device component manufacturer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Negative media or sanctions-list screening against a UBO or counterparty.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver SBP-compliant enhanced due diligence packets: international criminal-record and politically-exposed-person (PEP) clearance, references from two licensed financial institutions, notarized and apostilled birth/passport documents, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth statements, and a sworn affidavit explaining the business rationale and physical trade chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medical-device export activity without a local sanitary registration or ISO 13485 certificate.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit Ministry of Health (MINSA) medical-device registration status or a valid waiver, ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 certificates, FDA or CE marking evidence for the digital X-ray flat-panel detectors, end-customer purchase orders, supplier invoices, and a detailed product compliance matrix showing the goods are not subject to weapons, explosives, or dual-use export restrictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of third-party capital injection or intra-group loans.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the shareholder capital contribution resolution, executed subscription agreement, bank reference letter from the remitting institution, copy of the remitting bank's own KYC approval, audited financial statements of the parent or investor, treasury source-of-funds letter, and a statement of the foreign exchange conversion chain, if any, showing no crypto, gambling, or unregulated payment funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shareholder or director changes immediately before account opening; bearer-share suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Produce a chronological share-transfer register stamped by the registered agent, legal opinion from a Panamanian counsel confirming the absence of unregistered bearer instruments, updated Regulación? not required; rather, certificates of good standing for the corporate vehicle, a certificate of non-issuance or full custody immobilization of bearer shares, and a board resolution fixing current beneficial ownership.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital contribution must be transmitted by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank account to the Panamanian operating bank. There is no mandatory Panama-specific SWIFT purpose code, but the wire must carry a clear beneficiary reference 'PA_CORP capital contribution - digital X-ray detector manufacturing' together with a board resolution, subscription agreement, and source-of-funds documentation. The receiving Panamanian bank may independently classify the inflow as Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) and request the DGI tax identification number (RUC) and Panamanian company registration data. No central bank pre-approval, exchange-control certification, or inward FDI registration exists.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement of supplier invoices for components, amorphous-silicon panels, cesium iodide scintillators, and electronics is effected through (i) SWIFT MT103 international wire transfers for non-documentary high-confidence suppliers, and (ii) irrevocable confirmed commercial letters of credit (L/C) at sight, subject to UCP 600, for large capital-equipment purchases. Payment instructions must be supported by a purchase order, commercial invoice, transport document (e.g., bill of lading or air waybill), packed/commercial invoice set, and where required the MINSA import certificate. For L/C transactions, the issuing bank should route through a correspondent with the beneficiary's bank using SWIFT MT700 issuance and MT202/MT103 cover payment. All outbound wires must pass standard SBP transaction monitoring and OFAC-complementary screening.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla foreign-exchange forwards on non-USD currencies (USD/EUR, USD/CNH, USD/GBP) with ISDA credit support annexes.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies with limited deliverability, cash-settled in USD in accordance with SBP-permitted banking practice.
Cross-currency swaps between USD and major convertible currencies where a customer has committed production and procurement cash flows.
FX options and zero-cost collars for tactical hedging of non-USD procurement and receivables, subject to the bank's market-risk desk approval.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Declaración Jurada Anual de Renta) for the Sociedad Anónima, zero or operative filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance of Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 15 March following the calendar tax year (fiscal year-end 31 December); extension available only by formal DGI resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 10% of the tax due plus monthly arrears interest (approximately 1.5% per month); suspension of DGI clearance certificates (paz y salvo); nominal fines for late zero returns; directors and the resident agent exposed to administrative liability

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate franchise tax (Impuesto Anual de Sociedades / matrícula) based on paid-in capital tier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI); payment collected through Banco Nacional de Panamá and recorded against the company file at the Registro Público de Panamá
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 30 June of each calendar year; minimum tier for paid-in capital up to USD 10,000 is USD 250
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% statutory surcharge if paid after 30 June; registration of corporate documents blocked while in arrears; two consecutive unpaid years trigger administrative strike-off (disolución de oficio) by the Registro Público

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal operating patent renewal (Patente Municipal / Aviso de Operación) applicable only where the S.A. maintains a physical establishment or payroll in Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipalidad del corregimiento where the establishment is located (e.g., Municipality of Panama)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: First fiscal quarter of the calendar year, generally 31 March; fee rate scales with registered capital and fixed assets
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine equal to 10% of the patent fee; suspension of the commercial operating license; municipal executory collection proceedings

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit and audited financial statements are compulsory for: (i) issuers regulated by the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores (SMV); (ii) banks, insurers, and other supervised financial entities; and (iii) taxpayers designated as Large Taxpayers (Gran Contribuyente) by the DGI, generally where annual gross income exceeds USD 3,000,000. Other private Sociedades Anónimas are not statutorily required to file audited financial statements, but must keep books enabling DGI inspection and tax reconciliation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (NIIF) as adopted in Panama for general-purpose financial statements; private S.A.s may apply the IFRS for SMEs standard; the books must reflect sound accounting practice and substantiate the annual tax reconciliation (conciliación fiscal) with the DGI.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Law 23 of 2015 (as amended) obliges the resident agent to obtain, verify, and retain ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) data at incorporation and to update such data within 30 days of any share transfer or ownership change. No standalone fixed annual UBO declaration applies to private S.A.s; the official final-beneficiaries register (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales) is event-driven, and the resident agent must re-confirm UBO particulars during the annual KYC review. Non-compliance exposes both the S.A. and the resident agent to administrative and monetary penalties under the Panamanian AML regime.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Registro de Accionistas / stock ledger)
Minute Book of Shareholders and Directors (Actas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300–900 per year for resident agent, registered office, and compliance gateway
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000–10,000 per year for a certified audit and tax reconciliation, required only when mandated by law or requested by the DGI

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation: only Panama-source income is subject to ISR; foreign-source income (e.g., export sales where title and risk pass abroad) is exempt. CAIR (Cuota Adicional al Impuesto de Renta) of 4.17% of assessable gross revenue acts as an advance minimum tax creditable against final ISR. Small taxpayers with annual gross income up to USD 200,000 may elect the RTS simplified regime at 2% of gross revenue. SEM (Multinational Headquarters) licensees access 0% on foreign-source income and 5% on qualifying exports of services. Dividends received from other Panamanian corporations are exempt from ISR.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 49 (Declaración de Renta / Income Tax Return) filed electronically through the DGI portal 'SITIO' (Sistema Integrado de Trámites y Operaciones) using the taxpayer's RUC and authorized public accountant's digital signature.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year entities, by March 31 of the following tax year. Two mandatory advance payments of 50% each of the prior year's ISR/CAIR are due by June 30 and October 31 of the current fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A - RUC / DV / Legal Name
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC), verification digit, corporate name, and registered agent address in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the S.A.'s Panama RUC; provide foreign beneficial owner's Tax Identification Number for CRS and beneficial-ownership registry purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax year covered (default 1 January to 31 December); any approved alternative fiscal year must be evidenced by DGI resolution.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the exact 12-month period; newly incorporated entities adopting a non-calendar year must attach the DGI approval letter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All Panama-source gross income: local sales of digital X-ray flat-panel detectors, installation services, and after-sales support invoiced to Panama-based hospitals and distributors; export sales are included only if title and risk pass in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exclude foreign-source income (e.g., wholesale sales delivered and titled abroad); attach a sworn statement identifying the excluded items per Article 694 of the Fiscal Code.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Necessary costs and expenses attributable to Panama-source income: cost of raw materials (amorphous silicon panels, cesium iodide scintillator deposition), cleanroom utilities, wages, depreciation of production equipment, and amortization of industrial property.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions require valid invoices issued by suppliers holding a Panama RUC; cross-border payments to related parties must satisfy transfer pricing documentation and the beneficial-ownership rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 3 - Net Taxable Income (Renta Neta Gravable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Line 1 minus Line 2; if negative, the loss is available for carryforward against future taxable income for up to five years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-owned S.A. engaged exclusively in foreign-source transactions reports zero net taxable income; the nil return must still be filed to avoid sanctions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax computed at 25% of Line 3; taxpayers with annual taxable income not exceeding USD 50,000 apply 15% on the first USD 11,000 and 25% on the excess.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders' dividend tax is not declared here; it is withheld separately under Article 733 of the Fiscal Code at the time of distribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute 4.17% of gross income subject to ISR; final periodic tax is the higher of Line 4 or Line 5, with CAIR creditable as an advance toward future ISR.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: CAIR base excludes foreign-source income; maintain a detailed gross-revenue reconciliation to support the computation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 6 - Advance Payments and Credits (Anticipos y Pagos a Cuenta)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits: the two compulsory advances (50% each of the prior year's ISR/CAIR paid June 30 and October 31), plus withholding taxes borne on Panama-source royalties and interest, and any CAIR already paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Unpaid advances must be declared here with default interest in the surcharge line; zero-income foreign-owned S.A. entities may apply for an advance-payment waiver.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 7 - Balance Due / Credit (Saldo a Pagar o a Favor)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax due (Line 4 or Line 5) minus Line 6; positive amounts are paid upon filing; negative amounts become refundable credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment must be executed via the DGI collection account with the RUC and period reference; international wire payments must include the Panama bank clearing code.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing/payment: surcharge of 10% of tax due if filed within the first 30 days, 20% within 60 days, and 30% thereafter; monthly default interest of 1% (12% p.a.) accrues on unpaid balances. Non-filing triggers fines up to USD 10,000, suspension of the RUC, blockage of import/export operations, and criminal tax evasion assessment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 392 - Declaración Informativa de Precios de Transferencia, filed via the DGI transfer-pricing module simultaneously with the Form 49 annual return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Same as Form 49: within three months of fiscal year-end (March 31 for calendar-year taxpayers).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate value of transactions with related parties by counterparty, jurisdiction, and nature: raw material purchases, intercompany loans, royalty/license fees, management services, and sales of finished detector units.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all transactions with the foreign parent and affiliates, including transactions where the Panama S.A. acts as import-only distributor or contract manufacturer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B - Arm's Length Method Applied
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: State the selected method per transaction category: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, or Profit Split, together with the comparability analysis and selection of tested party.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation; for an OEM X-ray detector manufacturer using routine distribution or toll manufacturing functions, TNMM with the foreign group's operating margin is the most commonly accepted method.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconcile the final ISR liability with transfer-pricing adjustments (if any) and the CAIR minimum-tax floor.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure intra-group pricing leaves an adequate taxable operating margin in Panama that is consistent with the entity's functional profile and risk allocation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Fines from USD 1,000 to USD 10,000 for non-filing or incomplete filing; the DGI may independently adjust taxable income using comparable margins, resulting in additional ISR, a 30% surcharge, and 12% p.a. interest.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends distributed from profits that have borne ISR or CAIR in Panama; 20% on dividends distributed from untaxed profits (e.g., where the company utilized loss carryforwards or obtained a CAIR/ISR exemption).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim a reduced treaty rate, the non-resident shareholder must: (i) obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from its home tax authority demonstrating beneficial ownership; (ii) transmit the TRC and a completed beneficial-ownership declaration to the paying Panamanian S.A.; (iii) have the paying entity submit the DGI validation request together with the relevant DTA provisions; (iv) ensure the Limitation on Benefits (LOB) clause is satisfied; (v) apply the reduced rate at source only after DGI validation. Any over-withheld amount is recoverable via the DGI 'Reposición' refund procedure within the three-year prescription window.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 12.5% statutory WHT on gross payments to non-residents for the use of industrial property rights (patents, designs, know-how) exploited in Panama; treaty rates are typically 5-10% (e.g., under the Panama-Netherlands DTA, 5% for certain royalties). Interest: 0% WHT on interest paid to non-resident creditors for inbound financing, as such interest is foreign-source income to the creditor under territorial rules; interest paid to resident creditors is subject to 6% WHT, creditable against the creditor's ISR.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 7,500,000 (Panama uses the US dollar as legal tender; no separate local-currency threshold). Mandatory submission of Form 392 and a Local File when annual gross revenue exceeds USD 7.5 million; a Master File is additionally required when the worldwide group's consolidated gross revenue exceeds USD 30 million. Taxpayers below the USD 7.5 million threshold must still maintain contemporaneous TP documentation when their related-party transactions exceed USD 250,000 in a fiscal year.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Requirements (ESR) apply under Law 70 of 2019 and implementing Decree 129 of 2020 to all Panamanian-resident entities conducting 'relevant activities,' including manufacturing, distribution, and shipping. The S.A. must demonstrate physical premises in Panama, full-time qualified employees, and core income-generating activities performed locally. Annual ESR compliance filings must be submitted to the DGI. Non-compliance results in fines from USD 5,000 to USD 500,000, suspension of the RUC and business license, and potential administrative dissolution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Wilful omission of Panama-source revenue on Form 49, such as failing to invoice domestic sales of X-ray detector units to Panama hospitals or clinics, or submitting forged supplier invoices to reduce the 25% ISR base.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of 2 to 10 times the tax evaded, plus a 30% surcharge, monthly default interest of 1%, and potential criminal imprisonment of 2 to 5 years under Article 729-A of the Fiscal Code; the taxpayer's name is published on the DGI infractors list.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who sign or supervise the false return are jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax and surcharges; criminal conviction carries imprisonment, a travel ban, and seizure of personal assets through the 'levantamiento del velo corporativo' doctrine.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Panamanian S.A. as an invoicing conduit or IP-holding shell without a real manufacturing facility, employees, or managerial presence in Panama, while claiming treaty benefits or shifting profits to zero-tax jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR fines of USD 5,000 to USD 500,000, suspension of the RUC and Aviso de Operación, administrative dissolution, and re-characterization of transactions by the DGI with 25% ISR, surcharges, and interest on deemed Panama-source income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly execute sham transactions are personally liable for ESR penalties; foreign parents face permanent-establishment exposure in Panama; travel bans and freezing of Panamanian bank accounts can be imposed as precautionary measures.
